items.quote: National will maintain three Budget Responsibility Rules to keep debt down, get back to surplus, and keep taxes low.
National will strengthen hunter-led conservation, protect access to the outdoors, and better recognise the value of hunting and fishing to New Zealand.
National will continue to ensure there are real consequences for crime by abolishing good character assessments at sentencing for all sexual offending.
